name: native-live-browser-only-local-features
description: 基于历史 local-features-plan 浏览器/工作区范围；首次启动已适配单步偏好页，其余动作保持原有范围。历史源索引保存在 historicalSourcePlan，当前索引见 coverage。

coverage.notes: 通过原始项目选择、workspace 文件树、隔离 evidence.txt 预览和只读预览断言验证真实本地文件链路。
所有 Git init/commit/worktree/add/list/diff/remove 和 Git Review 展示均由真实 PTY 与 UI 驱动；不使用 RPC 伪造结果。
验证真实 PTY prompt、命令回显、退出卸载及浏览器夹具 HTTP 服务启动。
通过真实 child WebView CDP 内容、原生 surface 可见性、target=_blank 新标签、popup 遮挡隐藏及菜单关闭恢复断言浏览器运行时。
从文件树真实返回任务并打开本地设置页，作为浏览器/文件链路的结束状态。
通过真实模型选择器选择隔离 provider/model 并验证 Composer 可用；本计划不发送模型请求。

knownGaps: 固定 0-98 原步骤中的 48-50 仅创建隔离本地 Skill/Memory 夹具作为原始 PTY 前置动作；它们不构成本计划的 Skills 或 Memory coverage。
固定 0-98 截止于设置页打开；原计划 99 之后的 MCP、Skills/Memory 读取、Plugins、工作流和其他后半段动作不复制、不运行、不计入本计划结果。
PreviewPane 仍按原计划断言为只读预览；本计划不把缺少内置编辑器误报为编辑能力通过。

steps.text: powershell -NoProfile -Command "git -C '${PROJECT}' init; if (`$LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'git init failed' }; git -C '${PROJECT}' config user.name NativeLive; if (`$LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'git user.name failed' }; git -C '${PROJECT}' config user.email native-live@example.invalid; if (`$LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'git user.email failed' }; git -C '${PROJECT}' add evidence.txt; if (`$LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'git add failed' }; git -C '${PROJECT}' commit -m '原生验收基线 / Native acceptance baseline'; if (`$LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'git commit failed' }; git -C '${PROJECT}' worktree add -b native-live-worktree '${PROJECT}\..\native-live-worktree' HEAD; if (`$LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'git worktree add failed' }; Set-Content -LiteralPath '${PROJECT}\..\native-live-worktree\isolated.txt' -Value 'NATIVE_WORKTREE_ONLY' -Encoding utf8 -ErrorAction Stop; if (Test-Path '${PROJECT}\isolated.txt') { throw 'worktree leaked into main project' }; Write-Output NATIVE_GIT_READY; Write-Output NATIVE_WORKTREE_ISOLATED"

steps.text:
powershell -NoProfile -Command "`$worktreeList = git -C '${PROJECT}' worktree list --porcelain | Out-String; if (`$LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'git worktree list failed' }; if (`$worktreeList -notmatch 'native-live-worktree') { throw 'worktree was not listed' }; git -C '${PROJECT}\..
ative-live-worktree' add isolated.txt; if (`$LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'worktree git add failed' }; git -C '${PROJECT}\..
ative-live-worktree' grep --cached --fixed-strings --quiet -- NATIVE_WORKTREE_ONLY -- isolated.txt; if (`$LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'staged worktree content missing' }; git -C '${PROJECT}\..
ative-live-worktree' diff --cached --quiet -- isolated.txt; if (`$LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { throw 'worktree diff unexpectedly empty' }; if (`$LASTEXITCODE -ne 1) { throw 'worktree diff failed' }; Write-Output NATIVE_WORKTREE_LISTED; Write-Output NATIVE_WORKTREE_DIFF"
